170:        The formatted style dictionary.
171:    """
172:    var_data = None  # Track import/hook data from any Vars in the style dict.
173:    out = {}

175:    def update_out_dict(
176:        return_value: Var | dict | list | str, keys_to_update: tuple[str, ...]
177:    ):
178:        for k in keys_to_update:
179:            out[k] = return_value

181:    for key, value in style_dict.items():
182:        keys = (

184:            if not isinstance(value, (dict, ObjectVar, list))
185:            or (
186:                isinstance(value, Breakpoints)
187:                and all(not isinstance(v, dict) for v in value.values())
188:            )
189:            or (isinstance(value, list) and all(not isinstance(v, dict) for v in value))
190:            or (
191:                isinstance(value, ObjectVar)
192:                and not typehint_issubclass(value._var_type, Mapping)
193:            )
194:            else (key,)
195:        )
196:
197:        if isinstance(value, Var):
198:            return_val = value
199:            new_var_data = value._get_all_var_data()
200:            update_out_dict(return_val, keys)
201:        elif isinstance(value, dict):
202:            # Recursively format nested style dictionaries.
203:            return_val, new_var_data = convert(value)
204:            update_out_dict(return_val, keys)
205:        elif isinstance(value, list):
206:            # Responsive value is a list of dict or value
207:            return_val, new_var_data = convert_list(value)
208:            update_out_dict(return_val, keys)
209:        else:
210:            return_val, new_var_data = convert_item(value)
211:            update_out_dict(return_val, keys)
212:        # Combine all the collected VarData instances.
213:        var_data = VarData.merge(var_data, new_var_data)
214:
215:    if isinstance(style_dict, Breakpoints):
216:        out = Breakpoints(out).factorize()
217:
218:    return out, var_data
